subject: Animation
title: Encanto and Musical Innovation
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Encanto and Musical Innovation.

hook.text: In 2021, Disney released Encanto, a film set in Colombia about a family with magical gifts.

buildup.text: Lin-Manuel Miranda wrote songs blending Latin American rhythms with Broadway storytelling.

discovery.text: We Don't Talk About Bruno exploded on social media and outperformed the film's official single.

twist.text: Bruno's viral success caught Disney off guard. The studio had promoted a different song entirely.

climax.text: Encanto showed that audiences, not marketing departments, now decide which moments become hits.

punchline.text: A song Disney did not promote became its biggest hit.

quiz.question: What unexpected thing happened with Encanto's music?
options: The film had no songs at all
We Don't Talk About Bruno went viral despite Disney promoting a different song as the lead single
Lin-Manuel Miranda refused to write songs

details.summary: Encanto's Lin-Manuel Miranda soundtrack made We Don't Talk About Bruno a bigger hit than the film itself. The film's exploration of intergenerational family trauma in a Colombian setting represented Disney's growing commitment to culturally specific storytelling.
details.whyItMatters: Encanto showed that Disney's musical formula could evolve beyond Broadway standards. Lin-Manuel Miranda's Latin-influenced songwriting and the film's exploration of family pressure resonated globally, especially through social media.
takeaways: We Don't Talk About Bruno became a social media phenomenon and number-one hit
Lin-Manuel Miranda's Latin-influenced music expanded Disney's musical identity
The film explored intergenerational trauma within a Colombian family setting

faq.question: Why did We Don't Talk About Bruno become such a massive hit?
faq.answer: Social media, especially TikTok, amplified the catchy, multi-character song into a viral phenomenon. It reached number one on the Billboard Hot 100, something no Disney song had achieved since Aladdin's A Whole New World three decades earlier.

faq.question: How does Encanto address family pressure?
faq.answer: The Madrigal family's magical gifts create expectations that suffocate individual identity. Mirabel's journey reveals that family love should not depend on productivity or performance. The theme of being enough without extraordinary achievement resonated with audiences worldwide.
